parsed: ConstructResult(hypothesis="When a stock opens within a tight range and shows high volume, it is likely to experience a large directional move in the next day's returns due to heightened uncertainty and exaggerated price reactions.", factors=[{'name': 'RangeVolumeZScore', 'expression': 'TS_ZSCORE($high - $low, 10) ? TS_ZSCORE($volume, 10) : 0', 'explanation': 'Combines the z-score of opening range with the z-score of volume, gating the volume score only when the range is tight. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross-sectional.'}, {'name': 'RangeVolumeRank', 'expression': 'RANK(TS_ZSCORE($high - $low, 10)) * TS_ZSCORE($volume, 10)', 'explanation': 'Ranks stocks by their tightness of opening range and multiplies by the z-score of volume. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross.'}, {'name': 'VolumeRangeCorrelation', 'expression': 'TS_CORR($return, $volume, 10) * RANK($high - $low, 10)', 'explanation': 'Correlates daily return with volume and multiplies by the rank of opening range. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross.'}, {'name': 'RangeVolumeMedian', 'expression': 'MEDIAN($high - $low) ? TS_MEAN($volume, 10) : 0', 'explanation': 'Uses the median of opening range as a gate, then computes the mean volume. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross.'}, {'name': 'VolumeRangeZScore', 'expression': 'TS_ZSCORE($volume, 10) * ZSCORE($high - $low, 10)', 'explanation': 'Multiplies the z-score of volume by the z-score of opening range. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross.'}, {'name': 'RangeVolumeHighday', 'expression': 'HIGHDAY($high - $low, 10) ? TS_MEAN($volume, 10) : 0', 'explanation': 'Gates the mean volume based on how long the stock has been in a tight range. Serves the mechanism of volatility regime and cross.'}])

ConstructResult(hypothesis='stocks with declining volatility over three days are more likely to outperform in the next period due to increased liquidity and investor confidence.', factors=[{'name': 'VOLATILITY_DROP_3D', 'expression': 'TS_ZSCORE(TS_STD($return, 3), 3) ? 1 : -1', 'explanation': "Computes the z-score of 3-day return volatility, then gates it to +1 or -1 based on whether it's below average. Captures stocks with declining volatility relative to the cross-section."}, {'name': 'VOLATILITY_RANK_3D', 'expression': 'RANK(TS_STD($return, 3)) * -1', 'explanation': 'Ranks stocks by 3-day return volatility; lower ranks indicate declining volatility. Multiplied by -1 to invert the sign for higher values to mean outperformance.'}, {'name': 'VOLATILITY_CORRELATION', 'expression': 'TS_CORR(TS_STD($return, 3), $return, 1)', 'explanation': 'Measures the correlation between 3-day volatility and next-day returns. Stocks with declining volatility that also show positive returns are highlighted.'}, {'name': 'VOLATILITY_GATED_RETURN', 'expression': '(TS_STD($return, 3) < TS_STD($return, 7)) ? TS_PCTCHANGE($return, 1) : 0', 'explanation': 'Gates next-day return magnitude only for stocks with declining volatility over 3 and 7 days. Focuses on stocks where volatility drops over time.'}, {'name': 'VOLATILITY_ZSCORE_RANK', 'expression': 'ZSCORE(TS_STD($return, 3)) * RANK(TS_STD($return, 3))', 'explanation': 'Combines z-score and rank of 3-day volatility. Stocks with low volatility and low ranks (declining volatility) get higher scores.'}, {'name': 'VOLATILITY_TREND_3D', 'expression': 'TS_PCTCHANGE(TS_STD($return, 3), 2)', 'explanation': 'Tracks the percentage change in 3-day volatility over two periods. Negative changes signal declining volatility, which is linked to outperformance.'}])

ConstructResult(hypothesis='Korelasi antara volume dan return pada periode sebelumnya memprediksi pergerakan harga yang signifikan pada periode berikutnya karena adanya kejenuh pasar dan respons yang berlebihan.', factors=[{'name': 'CorrVolReturn10', 'expression': 'TS_RANK(TS_CORR($volume, $return, 10), 10)', 'explanation': 'Mengukur korelasi antara volume dan return pada periode terakhir 10 hari, lalu menranknya untuk menangkap pola yang signifikan dalam hubungan antara volume dan return yang tidak biasa.'}, {'name': 'ZScoreVol10', 'expression': 'TS_ZSCORE($volume, 10)', 'explanation': 'Standardisasi volume pada periode terakhir 10 hari untuk menangkap volume yang ekstrem, yang seringa mengindikasikan kejenuh pasar atau perubahan besar dalam permintaan.'}, {'name': 'ZScoreReturn10', 'expression': 'TS_ZSCORE($return, 10)', 'explanation': 'Standardisasi return pada periode terakhir 10 hari untuk menangkap pergerakan return yang tidak biasa, yang seringa diakibatkan oleh respons berlebihan terhadap volume yang tinggi.'}, {'name': 'RankCorrVolReturn10', 'expression': 'TS_RANK(TS_CORR($volume, $return, 10), 10)', 'explanation': 'Mengukur korelasi antara volume dan return pada periode terakhir 10 hari, lalu menranknya untuk menangkap pola yang signifikan dalam hubungan antara volume dan return yang tidak biasa.'}, {'name': 'RankVol10', 'expression': 'TS_RANK($volume, 10)', 'explanation': 'Menrank volume pada periode terakhir 10 hari untuk menangkap volume yang sangat tinggi, yang seringa mengindikasikan kejenuh pasar atau perubahan besar dalam aktivitas spekulatif.'}, {'name': 'RankReturn10', 'expression': 'TS_RANK($return, 10)', 'explanation': 'Menrank return pada periode terakhir 10 hari untuk menangkap pergerakan return yang tidak biasa, yang seringa diakibatkan oleh respons berlebihan terhadap volume yang tinggi.'}])
